title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
title_zh: STARK：迈向真正能学习和记忆的个性化智能体
abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.
abstract_zh: 长期记忆对持续与用户交互的个性化智能体至关重要。现有架构通常只记录发生了什么，把事件为何发生、如何影响用户行为留给大语言模型（LLM）在检索后重新推断。STARK 提出双图记忆架构：在 Episodic Graph 中，交互事件作为节点，按时间、因果和语义关系相连；在 Insight Graph 中，节点是 LLM 提取的行为洞察，按支持事件的数量打分，而促成这些洞察的事件本身则作为连接节点的边。推理时，系统可直接检索有事件支撑的洞察，无需反复遍历历史交互。事件作为边的设计还支持将知识图谱投影到关系嵌入空间，在情境相似时跨用户迁移，为冷启动用户推断缺失的行为洞察。相较于现有最优方法，STARK 在 LongMemEval 信息抽取和 LoCoMo 开放域问答上的评审分数分别提高 1.48 和 0.93 分。在公开的 LongLaMP 摘要生成基准上，当图稀疏度为 5% 时，跨用户迁移使开放式评审分数提高 0.7 分，ROUGE-L 提高 3 分。
key_points_zh: Episodic Graph 将交互事件存为节点，保留时间、因果和语义关系。
Insight Graph 将事件用作洞察之间的边，并按支持事件数为洞察打分，使推理时可直接检索有据可查的行为知识。
相较于现有最优方法，LongMemEval 信息抽取和 LoCoMo 开放域问答的评审分数分别提高 1.48 和 0.93 分。
关系嵌入支持在相似情境下跨用户迁移；在 LongLaMP 上，图稀疏度为 5% 时，开放式评审分数提高 0.7 分，ROUGE-L 提高 3 分。

agent-memory.reason: 核心贡献是面向个性化文本代理的双图外部记忆：情节图保留交互经历，洞见图以支持行为洞见的事件为边，使后续推理可直接检索洞见。摘要报告了相对现有最佳方法的量化提升，但未提供足以分离双图结构与跨用户迁移各自作用的消融证据。
